_about: Named connections, defined once and referenced by any number of feeds. A feed names a source connection in source_config.json and a destination connection in destination_config.json, so many files arriving from the same Drive account and landing in the same catalog share one definition rather than repeating it.

sources._about: Where files are read from. Credentials are named, never stored - the service-account JSON lives only in the Databricks secret scope.

gdrive_primary.description: Service account used for all Drive ingestion.

auth._note: Share each Drive file or folder with service_account_email, or lookups return 404 rather than a permission error.

destinations._about: Where tables are written. One entry per catalog/schema target; the table name itself stays per feed in destination_config.json.

bronze_dev.description: Bronze layer of the dev data platform - raw ingested files.

silver_dev.description: Silver layer - defined for convenience; no feed writes here yet.
